verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs explicitly state it lets founders complete and submit IRS forms (including EIN applications, a core IRS form) entirely online without a fax machine, and this is described as 100% in-house rather than outsourced. There's no independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the EIN step, though general community reviews confirm smooth incorporation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'EIN' by name, independent/community confirmation of the EIN application step specifically, and details on turnaround time.
